title: Endorsements, November 3, 2026 General Election
generalEvidence: Endorsement card on the page (https://culvercitydems.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/NOV2026-ENDORSE-082526.png) headed "ENDORSEMENTS · NOVEMBER 3, 2026 · GENERAL ELECTION"
whyItCounts: Democratic political club in Culver City that endorses candidates and takes yes/no positions on ballot measures.
notes: List is an image on the page (read in Chrome); the page's text section 'Endorsements – June 2026 Election' and 2024 entries were not used. Measures omitted: Measure AA YES, Measure YV NO. A Sept 2, 2026 Culver City Crossroads article (https://culvercitydems.com is cited there) also reports the club endorsing Sydney Kamlager-Dove (CD37) at its August meeting; she is not on the club's own card, so she is not included.
